entry_conditions: `coldpress init` has scaffolded the project (coldpress.yaml + .claude/ + CLAUDE.md present)

acceptance_checks.description: `.coldpress/local-config.yaml` has `phase_1_completed: true` — set by intake Step 13 when all prior steps exited cleanly
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` from the last incomplete step. Its own Step 1 (mode detect) will detect `partial_completion` and resume automatically.

acceptance_checks.description: Phase-1 working-mode fields present in coldpress.yaml: user.preferred_ides, user.cadence, user.team_shape — written by intake Step 12
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 12 (working-mode) to capture IDE preference, cadence, and team shape.

acceptance_checks.description: butler.display_name is set in coldpress.yaml (default 'Butler' is acceptable — warn level)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 12 Q4 to confirm or rename Butler.

acceptance_checks.description: Sacred document `_context/sacred/context.md` exists with frontmatter `status: authored` (not merely `seed`) — seeded by intake Step 7, fully authored + sacred-signed-off by intake Step 11
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` from Step 7 (intent-seed) through Step 11 (synthesize) to author and sign off context.md.

acceptance_checks.description: The authored `_context/sacred/context.md` frontmatter validates against schemas/sacred-docs/context.schema.json
acceptance_checks.remediation: Inspect context.md frontmatter. intake Step 11 runs validate-schema before committing the write — if you hand-edited the file, revert to the authored shape or re-run Step 11.

acceptance_checks.description: Each of the 5 `_input/` subfolders (assets, vendor, raw, legacy, reference) has content OR a `.intake-skip` marker placed by intake Step 5
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 5 (material-solicitation) and either drop material into each subfolder or explicitly skip it.
